notes.title: Demo Version and Participation in Ukrainian Games Festival 2025
notes.notes:
[p]Hello![/p][p]
Today I am happy to share that we are taking part in the [b]Ukrainian Games Festival[/b]. For this event, we released a demo version of our game, and you can try it now.[/p][p][/p][p]It is very important for us to get your feedback. This will help us make the game better and more interesting for you. At the end of the demo, or when you lose, you will see a pop-up where you can leave your feedback about the gameplay and, if you want, share your ideas for the future of the project.[/p][p][/p][p]Please note: the demo version may have some bugs. Also, the save system is turned off for now because the game length is currently 125 turns.[/p][p][/p][p]Thank you for being with us! We hope you will enjoy what we prepared.[/p]

notes.title: Devlog #2 — UI Changes
notes.notes: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45693194/538f97f49fd2fdc91a112cb204658f88e1c84e1d.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Greetings! Today we decided to share some small news about the project.[/p][p][/p][p]UI and UX are an important part of the game. Of course, we want to make them better for a more comfortable gameplay experience. As we are preparing for an important event, we decided to improve our interface, make it more user-friendly, and place some elements in a better way. We are also working on the visual side of the project, so we have made some changes to the graphic assets too. [/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45693194/a9476e7121b2e9d46ed3d2f8ffab52a7d335009a.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]We hope to get feedback from players soon, which will help us improve. So stay with us and watch for the next updates.[/p]
